name: Pipework
desc: A piping isometric of a process unit — a header runs the length of the deck and branch lines break off and pick their way through three dimensions in Manhattan legs, elbowing round each other with real occlusion, flanged and valved and tagged, while coloured flow packets chase down every service and the whole spool sways gently on its axonometric axis.

energy.doc: flow rate + pipe weight + packet count and glow + plate drift

scale.doc: spool size vs frame — 2.2 crowds the sheet with big-bore pipe

density.doc: how many branch lines break off the header (3..9)

speed.doc: how fast the flow packets travel

hue.doc: plate tint and one of the service colours (plant/ghost styles)

rock.doc: how far the model swings about its vertical axis — 0 locks to a true isometric

anno.doc: annotation density: deck grid, tag bubbles, line numbers, legend, north arrow, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: shaded-tube plant spool / prussian cyanotype / aged engraved plate / additive x-ray ghost / pid (tubes collapse to single lines and every fitting becomes its flat P&ID symbol)

seed.doc: route topology, services, diameters, valve types, line numbers

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the sheet ground
